title: Cavemen Didn't Actually Live in Caves. So Where Did They Live?
description:
You have seen the caveman in cartoons, movies and Halloween costumes. But did your ancestors really live in caves? This video follows the evidence: why caves dominate the archaeological record, why they were more like seasonal shelters than homes, and what the real Ice Age homes looked like, from lakeside brush huts at Ohalo II in Israel to mammoth-bone houses at Mezhyrich in Ukraine. Then step deep into Bruniquel Cave, where Neanderthals built a ring of broken stalagmites 176,000 years ago, and see how survivorship bias shapes the way you picture the past.

Research behind this video: Edouard Lartet and Henry Christy (Reliquiae Aquitanicae, 1865-1875); Louis Figuier, Primitive Man (1870); Margaret Conkey and the Between the Caves project; Dani Nadel et al., PNAS 2004, Ohalo II bedding; Wei Chu, Pavlo Shydlovskyi and Andreas Maier, Open Research Europe 2025, Mezhyrich chronology; Jacques Jaubert et al., Nature 2016, Bruniquel Cave.

#caveman #prehistory #humanevolution #archaeology #history #neanderthal
